text: Sia's journey as an artist in NFT space, in web3 and on Solana started almost three years ago. I was raised in a family of artists and gallery owner. My father is a collector. So Sia is being raised inside of a similar atmosphere where I'm a designer and tattooer and artist all together. The turning point was when it hit us that she has all this incredible digital art that we wanted to show. She actually convinced me with her works and with her efforts that she really loves it, that she wants it, that she wants to create this world. One by one, you know, the collectors came, the community started to exist. Her first solo exhibition, Belgrade, is probably one of the highlights of my life. Like the whole organization, the time that it took to create it, the process that we went through to create all of these arts, having this much interest from people, from viewers and visitors of the exhibition, it was just overwhelming. The most surreal thing was seeing our Art on Exchange art exhibition on Breakpoint in Amsterdam in 2023. Seeing my art, besides my daughter's art on such an event. It was pretty mind blowing. So last month, through our friends from superteam Balkan, we were introduced to people from Soulflare and they love Sia's art and want to give opportunity to Sia to be a part of their upcoming products and Merch, which is going to be presented in Apex Budapest this month. What excites me is to see where she will be in three years, not even ten.
